notes.title: Happy New Year!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25149957/688459f44e33bcc1b76a137788fef26f9f460155.jpg[/img]
Greetings, friends! Happy New Year in advance! I wish you all the very best and most positive things—success in your plans, good health, and a peaceful sky above!

I would also like to share an article with you about the development of my current project, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1699230/Hail_to_the_Rainbow/]Hail to the Rainbow[/url]. This is the second part, dedicated to creating 3D content, working with materials, and surface shaders. I believe fans of behind-the-scenes game development will find some of the aspects of this process interesting. Unfortunately, this part is available only in Russian, but there is an introductory first part in English, which you can find [url=https://www.indiedb.com/games/hail-to-the-rainbow/tutorials/hail-to-the-rainbow-game-development-that-lasts-forever]here[/url].

[url=https://habr.com/ru/articles/870966/]Article.[/url]


See you in the New Year!

notes.title: Work on "Hail to the Rainbow" game is nearing completion
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43651098/4f50fbb48fad5525e5fb4195c08d0527a92628c0.jpg[/img]


Hello! I've been working on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1699230/Hail_to_the_Rainbow/]"Hail to the Rainbow"[/url] for five years now. Crazy timing, especially for an indie. The process is intense and emotionally difficult. With each new game you try to invest more and more, pay attention to details, you want to make everything as perfect as possible, and this makes development time longer

I finally completed the base of the game, finished all the locations, mechanics and started polishing the project. In general, there is still a lot of work, but the finale is already visible ahead. Last week I played the entire project for the first time, from start to finish. [b]Walkthrough took about 10 hours![/b]

Also, the voice acting for the game was recently completed. For the first time in my project there will be English voice acting. In my practice, this is a big and difficult step, I hope, despite the nuances, it will be a pleasant addition for players :)


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43651098/b4026e8fd69ae839665c7df9c593947373798aa8.gif[/img]

notes.title: Happy New Year!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Another year has passed, difficult for many, filled with emotional upheavals and uncertainty. Sometimes I wonder why people continue to play scary and depressing games when there are so many similar things around us in real life. But for some reason we love to immerse ourselves in virtual worlds like these. Perhaps it’s easier for us, because there the danger is just a scenario, we can easily stop events, put them on pause. In life, unfortunately, we cannot do this.

I wish you all good luck next year, so that real danger avoids you as much as possible, strength, good health and a peaceful sky above your head!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25149957/d25ae5a6c417179aae80a4926be97cdd7948db76.gif[/img]

My work continues. I had plans to update already released projects, but the current work on the Hail to the Rainbow game takes a lot of time. At the moment I am nearing the completion of the project. I really hope to complete the work by the end of 24. In the meantime, you can take a closer look at “Hail to the Rainbow” on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1699230/Hail_to_the_Rainbow/]Steam page[/url], and also watch a short New Year’s video based on the game.

[previewyoutube=QZchfXg-grM;full][/previewyoutube]

Happy New Year!

notes.title: Teaser of "Hail to the Rainbow" game.
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=LXV_-PPBm-w;full][/previewyoutube]


Greetings ! A lot of time has passed since the publication of the latest news, but the work has not stood still and I am finally happy to announce that my new project called "Hail to the Rainbow" has a   [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1699230/Hail_to_the_Rainbow/]page on Steam[/url] .

This is my fifth author's project, which is currently under development. The game takes place in an alternate universe. Advanced technology to improve the life of mankind, led to the collapse of mankind. Ideas about the world of the game appeared in my mind since the time of work on "7th Sector". This universe seemed to me extremely interesting and suitable for deep immersion and explore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35906195/532d5e0e1c82a31d6039219064c9f191c916a47f.gif[/img]

"Hail to the Rainbow" is a massive project with great attention to detail. The work has been going on for about 2 years and the final revision will take about the same amount (approximate forecast).


In the meantime, I will be glad for the interest shown and the addition of the game to the wishlist. There is a long way ahead, during which I will try to share materials and best practices. Some content will be published on the [url=https://www.patreon.com/SergeyNoskov]Patreon[/url]  channel.

Good luck to all!

notes.title: New Project
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25149957/3a4551b9e78f74427c9e4d20e819358739407770.jpg[/img]

Greetings friends! I announce the beginning of the development of a new project. Working title: "Rainbow" or "Glory to the Rainbow". I have very serious plans, the scale of the project is large, the idea is global and very detailed. Previously, I did not pay so much attention to the plot and history, I already foresee sleepless nights X)

The game is a kind of symbiosis of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/466500/35MM/?curator_clanid=33976621]35MM[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/749250/7th_Sector/?curator_clanid=33976621]7th Sector[/url]. I decided to use my most successful tricks - an atmosphere of despondency, devastation and post-USSR, seasoned with a dramatic story. The story of a boy named Ignat and his life after the war in alternative Russia. A deep study of the character, world and events is planned. The fantastic theme provides a lot of room for ideas.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25149957/3a4551b9e78f74427c9e4d20e819358739407770.jpg[/img]

As a basis for the main character, I decided to take the image of a boy from the video [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KJgYqlZeSy4]ZAMILSKA "CALL" / Elektro_sonda[/url]  
 As soon as I saw him (the boy), I realized that this is exactly the image that I want to see in the game.
A great inspiration for the future atmosphere of the project was given to me by the amazing works of Simon Stalenhag, on which I had my eyes for a long time (I am not attaching work, you can google it)

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25149957/6dd1a0af15cd2afe3e59d2698b12752235925fd8.jpg[/img]

Overall, I plan on improving the quality level a lot. I really hope that all the ideas will be implemented, although it will take a long time.

 I will keep abreast of developments and find a minute to publish!

Also, I will be very grateful for support, informational and in general of any kind!

PS.  In connection with Halloween, there will soon be an interesting competition with a cash prize associated with the project [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1077520/The_Light_Remake/?curator_clanid=33976621]The Light Remake[/url]. There will be a post next week!

notes.title: Book based on 35MM story
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25149957/435b62ea9483fb3bef81456b639efc854f4515be.jpg[/img]

Hello! A lot of time has passed since the release of 35MM, but the topic is post-apocalypse, disasters  to this day remains relevant. Especially now. 

It’s pleasant for the developer when the virtual world he creates acquires life in a different form. Often games become something big, fan art is drawn from them, stories, poems are written, films are made, etc. However, I had no serious expectations about this. I did not think that the story of 35MM could for example be transformed into a book.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25149957/39c5b5d652df77b23009a0fe5dd4b489ed236f5b.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25149957/331bd06b6f2f1236ec051e3b9a644af6d84d930b.jpg[/img][/url]

But today, under the authorship of Vitaly Pryadein, a book based on 35MM was published! The work carefully transfers the history and design of the project into a text format, complementing the narrative with interesting details, new plot elements and thoughts about life, death and morality. I did not take part directly in the writing process, but I actively advised. Also, the book includes my interview about creativity, development and a little about life.

Unfortunately, the book is only in Russian, but I just could not keep this news secret.
And sorry for the errors in the text! :)

 

I also remind  that work on the project  [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1077520/The_Light/]The Light[/url]  is nearing finish , I will be very grateful to everyone who adds the game to the wishlist!

Thank you all for your attention, have a nice day and good health!

Friends, in the Steam store published page of my new project "7th Sector". You can see the materials, screenshots and trailer. The new game is very different from previous ones by genre, setting and gameplay, which is associated with many difficulties and nuances. But all this is an interesting experience. 

7th Sector is a platformer with a lot of different puzzles and several "characters". All tasks are unique and individual for each character, associated with his abilities. The player will have to work on technical, electronic devices, and shoot and work with physics. 

In the process of passing the player will meet many plot details, which in the end will form a complete picture of the world. According to the tradition, there are several endings in the final, 4 for accuracy.

notes.title: CRUSH !!! - fix
notes.content:
If you have problems with running the game, or the game crush, try:
1. Enter commands in the startup parameters of the game

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25149957/ddba01b9610f3edd635f989dab8b481603d1acda.jpg[/img]

You can enter the parameters:

-force-d3d11-no-singlethreaded
-force-feature-level-11-0
-force-feature-level-10-1
-force-feature-level-10-0
-force-feature-level-9-3
-force-feature-level-9-2
-force-feature-level-9-1
-force-d3d9-ref
-force-gles30
-force-gles20
-force-d3d11
-force-opengl
-force-d3d9
-force-gfx-mt  
-force-gfx-st  
-force-gfx-direct
-popupwindow
-nolog

Options -force-feature-level - different levels of DirectX, these commands do the most good. Often helps function -force-feature-level-9-3, but if it does not help to you, then try all the commands, you have to find for themselves the best option.

A common cause of crashes at startup can also be the presence or absence of multi-threaded rendering. In this case, it is worth trying the command -force-gfx-mt and -force-gfx-st

2. Lower the game settings to a minimum quality 
3. Check the integrity of the game cache.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25149957/a4904ecb035d0300be7524bfdc499c9d01c09df5.jpg[/img]

4. Some cases, the game crash fix reinstalling drivers on video and sound card. Can help  reinstalling of  Windows and mute the microphone or other devices.
